question.problem:
Given that the random variable $X$ has the probability density function

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{108}x(x+2),\, & 0\le x\le 6 \\ 0,\, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

its cumulative distribution function is 

$$
F(x)={\begin{aligned}0,\, & x<0 \\ h(x),\, & 0\le x\le 6 \\ 1,\, & x>6\end{aligned}
$$

where $h(x)=${{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Since our random variable $X$ has a probability distribution function $f(x)$ that is strictly positive only for $0\le x\le 6,$ the cumulative distribution function takes the following form:

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x)={\begin{aligned}0, & x<0 \\ {\int }_{0}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t, & 0\le x\le 6 \\ 1, & x>6\end{aligned}
$$

For the given probability density function, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{0}^{x}\frac{1}{108}t(t+2)\,\text{d}t \\ \text{ } & ={\frac{1}{324}{t}^{2}(t+3)|}_{0}^{x} \\  & =\frac{{x}^{3}}{324}+\frac{{x}^{2}}{108}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the cumulative distribution function is given by

$$
F(x)={\begin{aligned}0, & x<0 \\ \frac{{x}^{3}}{324}+\frac{{x}^{2}}{108}, & 0\le x\le 6 \\ 1, & x>6.\end{aligned}
$$
